name: ATMEKSI
indications_original: ATMEKSI (methocarbamol) oral suspension is a muscle relaxant indicated as: an adjunct to rest, physical therapy, and other measures for the relief of discomfort associated with acute, painful musculoskeletal conditions in patients 16 and older.
contraindications_original: Adults Initial dosage: 1,500 mg (10 mL) 4 times daily Maintenance dosage: 750 mg (5 mL) every 4 hours or 1,500 mg (10 mL) 3 times daily Six grams a day are recommended for the first 48 to 72 hours of treatment. (For severe conditions 8 grams a day may be administered). Thereafter, the dosage can usually be reduced to approximately 4 grams a day.
warningsAndPrecautions_original: ATMEKSI (methocarbamol) Oral Suspension contains 750 mg/5 mL methocarbamol. It is a white to off-white suspension with a fruit flavor and is supplied in bottles of 150 mL with a child-resistant closure (NDC 69528-701-05).
adverseReactions_original: ATMEKSI is contraindicated in patients hypersensitive to methocarbamol or to any of the oral suspension components.
